title: Alice to UTA carrier and trading permission

requirements.action: Read local capabilities and request a trading operation.
requirements.expected: Local reads degrade explicitly; unsupported writes refuse rather than pretending success.

evidence.assertion: degrades local reads without touching the UTA HTTP client
evidence.scope: Alice client facade with an unreachable-client sentinel.

requirements.gap: Actual Alice/UTA HTTP status/error and reconnect behavior is not proved by the client stub.

requirements.initial: A separately loaded Broker Pack returns a structured error.
requirements.action: Decode it through the UTA protocol type.
requirements.expected: Known structured errors survive; unknown codes are rejected.

evidence.assertion: preserves a structured error from a separately loaded broker pack
evidence.scope: Wire-like object at the shared type boundary, not a running pack process.

requirements.gap: Real loopback approval/reconnect/replay behavior is covered by local-approval-http. Broker Pack version negotiation and running pack process compatibility remain separate.

requirements.initial: Isolated MockBroker plus real UTA route/manager, Alice SDK and persisted ledger.
requirements.action: Stage/commit and exercise stale, concurrent, readonly, reconnect, rejection and post-restart replay.
requirements.expected: Wire errors remain observable, invalid approvals do not write, one accepted proposal submits once, and failures do not become submissions.

evidence.assertion: refuses missing and stale approval hashes over real HTTP without a venue write
evidence.scope: Real loopback HTTP/SDK/Hono/UTA/TradingGit with an in-memory venue; no GUI/CLI authentication, separate UTA process or real paper venue.

evidence.assertion: honors a readonly mode change after staging and server readonly policy without a venue write
evidence.scope: Real loopback HTTP/SDK/Hono/UTA/TradingGit with an in-memory venue; no GUI/CLI authentication, separate UTA process or real paper venue.

evidence.assertion: serializes duplicate HTTP approvals and refuses replay after ledger restart
evidence.scope: Real loopback HTTP/SDK/Hono/UTA/TradingGit with an in-memory venue; no GUI/CLI authentication, separate UTA process or real paper venue.

evidence.assertion: reports transport loss and recovers the same prepared approval after HTTP reconnect
evidence.scope: Real loopback HTTP/SDK/Hono/UTA/TradingGit with an in-memory venue; no GUI/CLI authentication, separate UTA process or real paper venue.

evidence.assertion: preserves a venue rejection as a failed operation rather than successful submission
evidence.scope: Real loopback HTTP/SDK/Hono/UTA/TradingGit with an in-memory venue; no GUI/CLI authentication, separate UTA process or real paper venue.

evidence.assertion: cancels a loopback read without losing the prepared approval or writing to the venue
evidence.scope: Real loopback HTTP cancellation and subsequent read; venue is MockBroker. Server-side read is released in finally.
